sentences: On a day in full spring, a scholar on horseback stops right in the middle of the road.
He has turned his head, and at the end of his gaze a pair of orioles is calling back and forth in a willow by the path.
The boy holding the reins and even the horse seem to pause with him, so the whole picture holds its breath.
Kim Hong-do pushed the willow to one bank, set the little party on the road, and left almost everything else as empty paper.
That emptiness becomes the sky, the spring air, and the space the birdsong fills.

At the upper left, a poem about orioles over a spring river is followed by a note that his fellow court painter Yi In-mun viewed it and Kim Hong-do painted it, and the work was designated a Korean Treasure in 2018.
